name: Importance Sampling of Procedural Skies using Marginal and Conditional CDFs
definition: A method to sample directions for a procedural sky (spherical light) based on luminosity to reduce variance and computation time, avoiding the inefficiency of uniform sphere sampling.
summary: This method reduces variance in procedural sky sampling by using pre-integrated marginal and conditional CDF textures to concentrate samples in luminous regions, unlike geometric or analytical approaches.
